title: conscious-subconscious protocol envelope
description: The wrapper applied to every message on every transport. The Python implementation is src/conscious_subconscious/protocols/envelope.py and the TypeScript consumer is apps/console/src/api/types.ts; this schema is the tie-breaker between them.

v.description: Protocol version. A breaking change bumps this and older peers must refuse rather than guess.

id.description: Unique message identifier, used for de-duplication and correlating JSON-RPC replies.

ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset. Wall-clock time, not simulation time.

source.description: Component that produced the message, e.g. 'engine' or 'device.heart-rate'.

session.description: Session scope. Same character class as MQTT topics, so a session id can never smuggle in a topic separator or wildcard.

payload.description: Message-type-specific body, validated against that type's schema. Capped at 262144 serialised bytes.
